models_evaluated: UltraSight AI guidance with Philips Lumify handheld ultrasound

links.outcome: Two-step AI-ECG-gated FoCUS versus FoCUS for all: utilization and accuracy
links.effect: Two-step strategy kept PPV/NPV 96.1%/95.6% and limited FoCUS imaging to 47%, but lowered sensitivity versus AI-FoCUS for all (PPV 95.4%, NPV 98.0%).
links.quote: A two-step AI-ECG then AI-FoCUS strategy reduced FoCUS utilization, but lowered sensitivity compared with AI-FoCUS for all.

links.outcome: Standalone AI-ECG screening accuracy for structural heart disease
links.effect: AI-ECG alone had NPV 95.8% but PPV 29.6%, limiting standalone screening; FoCUS-based strategies were superior.
links.quote: AI-ECG alone yielded NPV 95.8% but PPV 29.6%, limiting standalone screening.

unlisted_practices: Real-time AI guidance enabling novice acquisition of focused cardiac ultrasound with blinded expert interpretation

links.outcome: Positive and negative predictive values of sequential AI-ECG and AI-FoCUS screening
links.effect: AI-ECG alone: PPV 29.6%, NPV 95.8%; positive AI-ECG followed by AI-FoCUS: PPV/NPV 96.1%/95.6%, with FoCUS imaging limited to 47%.
links.quote: A two-step strategy (positive AI-ECG followed by AI-FoCUS) maintained high PPV/NPV (96.1%/95.6%) but limited FoCUS imaging to 47%.

links.outcome: FoCUS imaging utilization and structural heart disease detection sensitivity
links.effect: Restricting AI-FoCUS to positive AI-ECG cases limited imaging to 47%, but lowered sensitivity versus AI-FoCUS for all. PPV/NPV were 96.1%/95.6% versus 95.4%/98.0%, respectively.
links.quote: A two-step AI-ECG then AI-FoCUS strategy reduced FoCUS utilization, but lowered sensitivity compared with AI-FoCUS for all.

links.effect: Standalone AI-ECG screening yielded a low positive predictive value of 29.6%.
links.quote: AI-ECG alone yielded NPV 95.8% but PPV 29.6%, limiting standalone screening.

links.effect: A two-step strategy combining AI-ECG with AI-guided ultrasound imaging achieved a high positive predictive value of 96.1%.
links.quote: A two-step strategy (positive AI-ECG followed by AI-FoCUS) maintained high PPV/NPV (96.1%/95.6%) but limited FoCUS imaging to 47%.
